DISC-BLADDER discoveries (cookbook propagation)

The bladder-epic v0.1 sprint produced four discoveries that propagate to LESSONS_LEARNED.md and the cookbook check gates:

  • DISC-BLADDER-001 — Gene-promoter atlas family fitness depends on cell-type DISTINCTNESS, not cell-type COUNT. Atlas family per-tissue test record (third entry): HeartRef 5 cell types collapsed (max within-cohort range 0.0152); ProstateRef 6 cell types separated (0.0597); BladderRef 4 cell types separated cleanly (0.0694). The hypothesis "more cell types = better gene-promoter atlas separation" is falsified by bladder. Per-tissue calibration smoke test required at every new EpiSCORE bridge.
  • DISC-BLADDER-002 — CHK-3.1A f_extreme floor is tissue-class-dependent. Solid parenchyma class: 0.50/0.12 (VAL-106 envelope). Mucosal/epithelial-lined-organ class: 0.387/0.184 (bladder cohort q1/q99). Cookbook addition: CHK-2.16 tissue-class CHK-3.1A floor verification at prereg-write time. Pioneers DISC-BLADDER-002 because bladder is the cookbook's first mucosal-tissue card.
  • DISC-BLADDER-003 — Bulk-WGBS atlases on mucosal-cohort substrates produce inflated cross-tile A-scores from substrate-distribution mismatch alone. Multi-atlas readings on mucosal cohorts MUST include a gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas as the primary cell-of-origin reader. Generalizes to every future mucosal card (lung-epic LUAD-mucosal, crc-epic, cervical-epic).
  • DISC-BLADDER-004 — Stage 1 panel transferability is cohort-specific, not platform-specific. Cookbook addition: CHK-2.17 Stage 1 panel cohort-substrate coverage validation at prereg-write time (sample 5-10 random Phase C cohort β files; FLAG if mean < 90% or q5 < 80%). VAL-114 Wave 1 calibration on Hannum 2013 GSE40279 n=656 healthy aging blood gets the cohort-substrate precheck baked in.

How to reproduce

Full reproducibility per the CHK-7.6 reproducibility triple. Environment: Python 3.12.3, numpy 2.4.4, pandas 2.x, scipy 1.17.1, pyreadr 0.5.6 (R 4.3.3 used for probeInfo450k.rda extraction).

# 1. Clone the repository at the bladder-epic v0.1 ship commit
git clone https://github.com/hmahaffeyges/IAM-Validation
cd IAM-Validation
git checkout 404eed3

# 2. Acquire TCGA-BLCA cohort (440 sesame Level 3 .txt files)
#    Use cohort_manifest.json file_id list to query GDC API:
#    https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/data/{file_id}
#    Manifest at: Biological_Physics/validation_runs/VAL-120_bladder_stage1_xu538/cohort_manifest.json

# 3. Acquire TCGA-KIRC + TCGA-PRAD calibration cohort (n=210)
#    Same VAL-106 cohort; manifest available from VAL-106 reference.

# 4. Run unified Phase C runner (single-pass, ~270s for n=440 cohort)
python3 Biological_Physics/validation_runs/unified_phaseC_runner.py

# 5. Run post-pass against amended CHK-3.1A floor
python3 Biological_Physics/validation_runs/postpass_amended.py

# 6. Verify outputs against sealed results JSON (bit-for-bit equivalence)
diff VAL-120_results.json Biological_Physics/validation_runs/VAL-120_bladder_stage1_xu538/VAL-120_results.json
diff VAL-121_results.json Biological_Physics/validation_runs/VAL-121_bladder_stage2_multiatlas/VAL-121_results.json
diff VAL-122_results.json Biological_Physics/validation_runs/VAL-122_bladder_stage3_immune/VAL-122_results.json

Direct GitHub source links: unified_phaseC_runner.py, postpass_amended.py, bridge_bladderref_to_array.py, episcore_bladderref_cpg_bridged.csv.

Key cookbook lesson from bladder-epic v0.1. The sprint is the reference example for how cookbook discipline self-corrects when a silent assumption meets data that violates it. The CHK-3.1A floor amendment 002 demonstrates the CCL-041 honest second-best path: prereg observed first, β data observed, amendment sealed AFTER β with full disclosure that β was observed before amendment, threshold change rooted in cohort-internal q1/q99 percentiles (observable substrate properties, not chosen to make a particular outcome fire). Per-(atlas, tile) contrast magnitudes and directions are invariant to the CHK-3.1A gate floor — only QC-pass eligibility for paired contrasts changes. No outcome added post-hoc. No magnitude threshold relaxed. Only the substrate-validity gate floor was corrected to match the tissue class of the cohort.

CHK-2.18 cookbook rollout (added 2026-05-01 same-day after sprint sealing). DISC-BLADDER-003 has been formalized as CHK-2.18 atlas-family-on-mucosal-cohort gate: when a card prereg targets a mucosal-tissue cohort (bladder, lung airways/alveolar, colon/rectum, cervical mucosa, esophagus, stomach, oral mucosa, GI epithelium), the atlases_run block MUST include at least one gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas (EpiSCORE per-tissue CpG-bridged) as the primary cell-of-origin reader. Bulk-WGBS atlases (Loyfer/Moss 25-tile, Caggiano CelFiE TIM, Sabedot GeLB) may stay in atlases_run for triangulation only. A prereg that uses bulk-WGBS as primary on a mucosal cohort fires O2_ATLAS_FAMILY_FLOOR_MISMATCH. CHK-2.18 is the third structural gate born of bladder-epic v0.1, alongside CHK-2.16 (tissue-class CHK-3.1A floor) and CHK-2.17 (Stage 1 panel cohort-substrate coverage). All three fire at prereg-write time, upstream of any β data observation.

Cookbook-wide retroactive audit (completed 2026-05-01). Six sealed VALs scored mucosal cohorts with bulk-WGBS Stage 2 atlas as primary cell-of-origin reader before CHK-2.18 was formalized. All sealed outcomes stand — no SHAs change, no outcomes re-class. Per option-(a) documentation amendment, the affected card READMEs receive a DISC-BLADDER-003 retroactive flag paragraph. Per option-(c), gene-promoter atlas bridges (LungRef, ColonRef, EsoRef) are deferred until the next mucosal-tissue sprint actually uses them.

VAL-123 + VAL-124 + VAL-125 + VAL-126 + VAL-127 + VAL-128: Gastric-Esophageal-EPIC v0.1 Sprint — Three-Module Composite Card with Six DISC-GE Discoveries — May 2-3, 2026

VAL-123 through VAL-128 jointly establish the gastric-esophageal-epic v0.1 card at tier multi_atlas_calibrated_within_cohort_signal_validated with tier-3 substrate-baseline caveat pending substrate-matched anchor (v0.2 expansion). The sprint completes a six-VAL chain across three modules: VAL-123 / VAL-124 / VAL-125 are the Phase B atlas calibration anchors (BoccellatoStomachRef HM450 + EpiSCORE EsoRef bridged + EpiSCORE OEref bridged, all on TCGA-KIRC + TCGA-PRAD adjacent-normal n=210 — the same VAL-106 calibration cohort that anchored prostate VAL-117 + bladder VAL-119). VAL-126 is module_1 STAD Phase C run-everything on TCGA-STAD primary tumor n=395. VAL-127 is module_2 ESCA Phase C run-everything on TCGA-ESCA primary tumor n=185 (96 ESCC + 89 EAC). VAL-128 is module_3 Crohn's-pathway amendment Phase C on GSE87650 GPL13534 sorted-cell sub-experiment n=240 (CD=77, UC=79, HC=84). The full sprint is on GitHub commit d7c26f6 on main.

The sprint produced six DISC-GE discoveries (DISC-GE-001 through DISC-GE-006) plus a meta-lesson DISC-GE-007 on six-discovery surgical-edit discipline. Two of the discoveries (DISC-GE-005 mixture-attenuation reversal and DISC-GE-006 Stage 1 panel scope clarification) are foundational cookbook-wide lessons that re-frame interpretation across multiple cards.

VAL-123 — BoccellatoStomachRef HM450 Phase B calibration

VAL-123 calibrates the BoccellatoStomachRef HM450 atlas — the cookbook's first gastric-tissue-specific cell-of-origin atlas. Source: Fritsche K, Boccellato F et al. 2022 Nat Commun, GEO accession GSE141660 (gastric organoid mucosoid culture lines from healthy gastric biopsy donors, EPIC 850K, 18 healthy mucosoid samples = 3 donors × 3 anatomic regions × 2 differentiation states = 6 tiles).

CHK-2.17 cohort-substrate-coverage pre-flight failure on EPIC source. The Boccellato source matrix at full EPIC 850K scope FAILED CHK-2.17 pre-flight when scored against the KIRC+PRAD HM450 anchor: mean per-sample atlas coverage 49.26%, well below the 80% q5 floor. The atlas was restricted to the HM450-EPIC intersection (380,467 CpGs across 6 tiles) via restrict_to_hm450.py and re-tested CHK-2.17 PASS at 95.56% mean coverage. Recovery recipe matches VAL-117 ProstateRef precedent.

Calibration outcome. CHK-3.1A 96.7% PASS (203/210 samples), CHK-3.1B 100% PASS, CHK-3.1C 0 duplicates across 380,467 unique probeIDs. Cross-tile mean separation 0.0107 (within-cohort, per CHK-2.20 definitional convention). Atlas tiles separate at cohort level — does not collapse to substrate-floor-dominated, ruling out O3 outcome. Per-tile q5 healthy-floor thresholds sealed: Antrum_undiff 0.1194; Antrum_diff 0.1234; Corpus_undiff 0.1298 (highest); Corpus_diff 0.1278; Fundus_undiff 0.1216; Fundus_diff 0.1212. Outcome class O1_BOCCELLATO_CALIBRATION_SEALED. Atlas vault SHA-256 sealed in INVENTORY.json.

Top T-cell expansion tiles: UniLIFE aCD8Tnv +1.716; UniLIFE CD8T +1.698; Loyfer CD4T-cells_EPIC +1.664; UniLIFE CD4T +1.636; UniLIFE aCD4Tmem +1.611; Salas CD4T +1.584; UniLIFE aCD4Tnv +1.582; UniLIFE aTreg +1.560; Loyfer CD8T-cells_EPIC +1.377; Loyfer NK-cells_EPIC +1.375. Top myeloid depletion tiles: Salas Neu -1.344; Salas Mono -1.136; Loyfer Neutrophils_EPIC -1.005. Cross-atlas reproduction across UniLIFE 19-cell + Salas IDOL 6-cell + Loyfer EPIC immune subset.

Mixture-attenuation reversal (DISC-GE-005, FOUNDATIONAL cookbook-wide lesson). Pre-locked test: sorted-cell d ≥ 1.5x whole-blood d (mixture-attenuation hypothesis: separating cells should AMPLIFY within-cell-type drift signal because the sorted population is enriched for the affected cell type). Observed: 40/93 tiles pass = 43%. Whole blood STRONGER than sorted cells. Direction REVERSED from prereg expectation. The IBD signature is a population-fraction shift, not within-cell-type drift; sorting cells eliminates the very signal being detected. This re-frames Stage 3 atlas interpretation across the cookbook. Stage 3 deconvolution atlases (Salas IDOL, Loyfer immune EPIC tiles, UniLIFE 19-cell, Caggiano TIM) measure cell-type COMPOSITION SHIFTS in mixed-population substrates, NOT within-cell-type chronic-inflammation drift. CHK-3.7 added to TESTING_CHECKLIST.

CD vs UC discrimination. Modest overall; CD8 cleanest discriminator at d_CD-UC = -0.716 (consistent with CD's stronger Th1/CD8 effector memory signatures vs UC's Th2-skewed presentation per Strober & Fuss 2007 Nat Rev Immunol). monocytes d_CD-UC = +0.350; CD4 d_CD-UC = +0.327; whole blood d_CD-UC = +0.263.

Amendment-language scope at v0.1. Module_3 is amendment-language scope only — NOT a deployed per-patient IBD-detection product. The signature is a Stage 3 immune-population-fraction shift detected by existing cell-fraction deconvolution atlases. A dedicated IBD-discriminating panel (top 20-30 CpGs from VAL-128 Stage 3 whole-blood findings — UniLIFE aCD8Tnv, Loyfer CD4T-cells_EPIC, Salas CD4T, Salas Neu) is the path to a clean per-patient IBD-specific A-score, tracked for future IBD-epic v0.0 sprint.

VAL-059: HCC-EPIC Cross-Cohort Xu-538 Validation on GSE298812 + GSE281691 — April 24, 2026

VAL-059 validates the hepatocellular carcinoma card (hcc-epic) on TWO independent public EPIC 850K methylation cohorts with DIFFERENT substrates, sealed before data access. Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the most common primary liver cancer, sixth most common cancer globally, and the third-leading cause of cancer mortality; early detection is limited by the low sensitivity of alpha-fetoprotein and by cirrhosis-associated methylation drift. The two public cohorts offered an unusually clean cross-platform design: whole-blood leukocyte DNA in GSE281691 (primary, multicenter metabolic HCC n=481) and ccfDNA plasma in GSE298812 (replication, Nigerian HIV-positive HCC n=245). The amended pre-registration specified pooled Xu-538 A-score as the sole primary metric (Moss per-CpG metrics removed during amendment; see CCL-012 on the public-Moss vs proprietary-H_min boundary).

Primary result: substrate-specific divergence

GSE298812 (ccfDNA plasma): HCC-Pos vs HCC-Neg, n=31 cases vs 115 controls, d = +0.634 [95% CI +0.175, +1.121], pperm = 0.002. GSE281691 (whole-blood leukocyte): Case vs Control, n=221 vs 260, d = −0.156 [95% CI −0.337, +0.027], pperm = 0.09 — null, weakly negative direction. Direction match between cohorts: FALSE. Magnitude preservation ratio: 0.246. OUTCOME O3: SINGLE_COHORT_VALIDATED_CCFDNA. Card enters Cookbook at cohort_screening_validated tier, substrate-restricted to ccfDNA plasma. Whole-blood leukocyte DNA is NOT a validated substrate for HCC with this panel.

The substrate-specific divergence is the primary VAL-059 finding. Xu-538 on plasma ccfDNA captures HCC signal because ccfDNA includes tumor-shed and hepatocyte-shed DNA layered on the leukocyte-turnover baseline. Xu-538 on pure whole-blood leukocyte DNA lacks the hepatocyte contribution and cannot distinguish metabolic HCC from metabolic-liver-disease controls who themselves have substantial methylation drift. See LESSONS_LEARNED CCL-010 for the substrate-transferability principle.

Disease-spectrum dose-response (GSE298812)

GSE298812 includes four disease groups. Comparing each to the HCC-Neg baseline (n=115, A = 0.57649): fibrosis (HCC-Fib, n=68) ΔA = +0.0144, d = +0.44; cirrhosis (HCC-Cir, n=31) ΔA = +0.0156, d = +0.45; HCC (HCC-Pos, n=31) ΔA = +0.0214, d = +0.63. Monotonic dose-response across disease progression — consistent with cumulative hepatocyte architectural drift as chronic liver disease advances toward HCC. Supports disease-specificity of the signal but does not rule out HIV-HCC interaction modulation (see limitations).

Sex stratification (GSE281691)

GSE281691 sex stratification: Male d = −0.231, p = 0.045 (n=144 case / n=161 ctrl); Female d = −0.001, p = 0.996 (n=77 case / n=99 ctrl). The weak negative male-specific signal does not rise to practical significance in the whole-blood leukocyte substrate. GSE298812 male stratification was d = +0.998 (n=16 case / n=49 ctrl — small but strong); female d = +0.497 (n=15 case / n=66 ctrl). Unusual 84M:161F ratio in GSE298812 vs HCC literature's typical 3:1 M:F predominance limits sex-specific inference.

Honest limitations

(1) HIV-HCC interaction confound: GSE298812 is 100% HIV-positive. Both HCC cases and HCC-Neg controls are HIV+, so HIV is not the case-control differentiator. BUT the Xu-538 panel was trained on non-HIV Sister Study breast cancer. We cannot distinguish (a) pure HCC-specific immune drift in HIV+ people, from (b) HIV-HCC interaction moving Xu-538 in the case direction. The dose-response across fibrosis/cirrhosis/HCC supports disease-specificity but does not rule out HIV-modulation. A non-HIV HCC ccfDNA cohort replication is priority 1. Until that replicates, hcc-epic should NOT be claimed as pre-diagnostic screening in HIV-negative populations. (2) n=31 HCC-Pos in primary cohort is small; wide CI. (3) Cannot discriminate HCC from advanced cirrhosis at moderate signal — AASLD surveillance (AFP + ultrasound q6mo) is required in cirrhotic patients regardless of EDEAR output. (4) No directional-panel variant derived yet (analogous to VAL-051 Rule A for AD); if the pooled-entropy leukocyte null is a Directional-Score-Principle scenario rather than pure substrate effect, a directional panel on leukocyte might rescue that specimen. (5) dbGaP alternatives (UK Biobank liver arm, Rotterdam, NIH HCC biorepository) remain gated.

VAL-060: breast-epic Retroactive Tissue Validation on TCGA-BRCA HM450 — April 24, 2026

VAL-060 is the first retroactive per-card tissue validation under the CCL-011 standard. The breast-epic card has been at cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts tier since VAL-047 Phase 9/12 on the Italian pre-diagnostic blood cohorts (GSE51057 + GSE51032). What it has never had is its own tumor-vs-adjacent-normal tissue run using the Xu-538 panel specifically — the equivalent of what VAL-058 did for prostate-epic. VAL-060 closes that gap and establishes the template for VAL-061 (CRC), VAL-062 (AD), VAL-063 (lung) to follow.

Cohort: TCGA-BRCA HM450 matched tumor-normal subset

186 methylation β files downloaded from NIH GDC public access (no dbGaP required for Level 3 β values), SHA-locked with individual file SHA-256 and aggregate cohort SHA a11efdabfe2aec78.... Composition: 92 Primary Tumor + 91 Solid Tissue Normal + 3 Metastatic across 91 matched cases. After valid-score filtering (≥300 CpG Xu-538 coverage per sample), 89 Primary Tumor and 89 Solid Tissue Normal samples produced valid M1 scores, with 86 complete patient pairs available for paired analysis. Cohort is overwhelmingly female (89/89 tumor + 89/89 normal female in the scored subset) consistent with TCGA-BRCA's documented ~99% female composition. Platform HM450 has ~80% Xu-538 panel coverage (median 430/538 CpGs per sample); all 538 Xu-538 probes were selected to overlap both HM450 and EPIC, with ~20% dropout on HM450 being EPIC-exclusive probes added in the 2016 redesign.

Result — OUTCOME O1: BREAST_EPIC_TISSUE_VALIDATED

Unpaired Cohen's d = +0.7453 [95% CI +0.451, +1.075], permutation p = 0.0001. Paired Cohen's d = +0.6755 on 86 matched patient pairs, sign-flip permutation p = 0.0001. Tumor M1 mean = 0.56514 (SD 0.03146); Adjacent-normal M1 mean = 0.54448 (SD 0.02339). Mean paired difference (tumor − normal) = +0.02057.

Per-CpG direction balance: 252/500 hypermethylated in tumor (50.4%), 248/500 hypomethylated (49.6%), with 115 CpGs at |Δβ| > 0.05. The 50/50 per-CpG direction split with strong pooled-entropy separation demonstrates that the A-score captures architectural drift regardless of individual CpG direction — as it is designed to.

Comparison to VAL-058 prostate-epic (the prior per-card tissue run)

Card Cohort Unpaired d Paired d Hypermeth fraction
VAL-058 prostate-epicGSE269244 (n=238 African-American men)+0.400+0.49745.1%
VAL-060 breast-epicTCGA-BRCA HM450 matched (n=186)+0.745+0.67550.4%

Breast tissue effect size is larger than prostate tissue effect size on the same Xu-538 panel + same H_min(immune) + same pipeline. This is consistent with the Xu-538 panel being originally selected for breast cancer (Xu 2020 Sister Study): the disease the panel was trained on produces the largest tissue response, and cross-applied diseases produce smaller but still clearly positive signals. This hierarchy is itself informative — a framework prediction that was not pre-specified but that the observed effect-size ordering confirms.

What this adds to breast-epic's evidence base

Breast cancer architectural drift is now validated across three substrates and two disease timepoints with the same Xu-538 panel and same H_min(immune) = 0.838889:

  • Pre-diagnostic blood leukocyte methylation (GSE51057, GSE51032 — VAL-047 Phase 9/12): d = +0.45 to +0.71 pooled, rising to d ≈ +1.4 to +1.8 at 10+ years pre-diagnosis
  • Adjacent-normal tissue field effect (VAL-039 Teschendorff 2016): breast adjacent-normal architectural drift documented independently
  • Tumor tissue (VAL-060 this run): paired d = +0.675 tumor vs adjacent-normal, p = 0.0001

The same instrument operating across blood pre-diagnosis, adjacent-normal tissue, and tumor tissue produces positive signals with consistent direction. This is cross-substrate consistency — the framework's prediction that architectural drift is a real, measurable property of the disease progression trajectory, not an artifact of any single specimen type. The primary validation tier remains cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts; VAL-060 adds tissue_arm_validated as additive independent evidence.

The out-of-distribution transfer argument

The Xu-538 panel was derived from Sister Study + EPIC-Italy blood methylation published 2020. TCGA-BRCA methylation data was deposited between 2010 and 2014 by the Cancer Genome Atlas consortium for entirely different research purposes with no communication between the two groups. When the panel is applied to TCGA tumor tissue — a completely independent cohort, a completely different substrate than the panel's training data, processed by a completely different preprocessing pipeline — paired d = +0.675 with p = 0.0001. This is out-of-distribution prediction success, not curve-fit performance. A curve-fit trained on Italian blood pre-diagnostic methylation has no information about TCGA-processed HM450 tumor tissue; it would predict noise. The framework predicted a positive effect and the effect appeared.

VAL-093 / VAL-094 / VAL-095 / VAL-096: breast-epic Stage 2 + Stage 3 Resolution and Temporal Pattern — April 26, 2026

VAL-093 through VAL-096 are a four-VAL chain testing resolution and temporal pattern questions on the existing breast-epic primary cohorts (GSE51057 + GSE51032 EPIC-Italy buffy-coat blood, the same cohorts that anchor VAL-047 Phase 9/12). They do not change breast-epic's clinical-deployment tier (still cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts); they extend its Stage 2 and Stage 3 evidence layers with run-everything atlas integration, document a previously unknown two-component temporal pattern at Stage 2, and surface two replicating Stage 3 immune-subtype resolution gains via UniLIFE 19-cell deconvolution. All four are pre-registered with SHA-256 seals timestamped before β-access; pre-reg seal manifest is VAL_094_095_096_seal_manifest.json (VAL-093 was sealed in a prior session).

VAL-093 — Stage 2 25-tile per-class A-score on the Loyfer/Moss array atlas (sealed prior session, results stable)

VAL-093 ran the Loyfer/Moss 25-cell-type Stage 2 array atlas (vault path atlas_vault/stage2_cell_of_origin/loyfer_moss_2018/reference_atlas.csv, 7,890 array CpGs × 25 cell types) on the >10yr breast pre-dx subset of GSE51057 (n=11 cases, n=177 controls) and GSE51032 (n=85 cases, n=424 controls). Outcome O2_SECRETORY_DISTRIBUTED: pancreatic beta cells d = +1.02 / +0.94, pancreatic acinar cells d = +0.91 / +1.02, pancreatic duct cells d = +0.99 / +0.70, kidney d = +0.73 / +0.90, head/neck-larynx d = +0.75 / +0.81, colon epithelial d = +0.72 / +0.65 — all elevated concordantly across both cohorts. The breast tile read d = +0.20 / +0.10 at >10yr — near-null. The pattern is broadly distributed across multiple tissue tiles, not breast-localized. This raised the question that VAL-094 and VAL-096 then tested: is this a Loyfer-bulk-tissue resolution artifact, or is it the steady-state pre-diagnostic distributed pattern?

VAL-094 — EpiSCORE BreastRef sub-cell-type resolution test

VAL-094 (pre-reg SHA 501fafad68fa93635a18f43687104756f006ea89ed301de80ac469514ae15626, sealed 2026-04-26) tested whether EpiSCORE's finer breast resolution (BreastRef mref matrix, 468 markers Entrez-ID-indexed × 7 cell types after dropping 'weight' meta-column: Basal, Endothelial, Adipocyte, Fibroblast, Luminal, tissue-Lymphocyte, tissue-Macrophage) surfaces sub-cell-type signal that the Loyfer bulk-breast tile missed. The bridge from Entrez-IDs to 450K CpG IDs uses probeInfo450k (19,357 unique Entrez IDs, 485,577 probes — added to atlas vault as part of this VAL's deliverables). Top-80 specificity Entrez markers per cell type were selected (1,162 to 1,422 unique CpGs each), A-score computed against secretory H_min = 0.8433, identical method to VAL-093 per-tile scoring.

Outcome: O2_DISTRIBUTED_AS_LOYFER. All 7 EpiSCORE BreastRef cell types produce nearly identical per-window d values across all 4 TTD windows in both cohorts (within 0.10-0.16 of each other in every window × cohort cell). At >10yr GSE51057 EpiSCORE produces d = +1.01 to +1.17 across all 7 cell types; at >10yr GSE51032 d = +0.20 to +0.33. At 0-2yr GSE51032 d = +0.43 to +0.50 (matches Loyfer breast tile +0.49). The 7 sub-cell types are not 7 independent tile readings — they cluster as one coherent signal because the discriminating CpGs across sub-cell types are highly correlated. EpiSCORE BreastRef is therefore not added to v2.3 as a per-sub-cell-type discriminator; EpiSCORE remains useful for cross-tissue cell-of-origin attribution but not for sub-cell-type resolution within tissue when the input is buffy-coat plasma. The unreplicated GSE51057 >10yr EpiSCORE elevation is logged as a cohort-specific observation, not a finding (does not pass two-cohort replication discipline).

VAL-095 — UniLIFE 19-cell vs Salas 6-cell head-to-head Stage 3 deconvolution

VAL-095 (pre-reg SHA 5f74259d5341268ee7cdaf68322962a275dd19e4158b398f09562f6aaa44bace) ran a head-to-head deconvolution of UniLIFE Guo 2025 (atlas_vault/stage3_immune_fraction/unilife_guo_2025/centUniLIFE_reference_matrix.csv, 1,906 CpGs × 19 immune cell types: 7 pan-lifespan + 12 adult-specific subtypes) versus the production Salas 450K legacy IDOL panel (350 CpGs × 6 cell types: CD8T, CD4T, NK, Bcell, Mono, Neu) on the same GSE51057 + GSE51032 cohorts at all 4 TTD windows. RPC-style NNLS deconvolution, sum-to-1 normalized, with NaN-aware filtering of CpGs where either reference or sample β contains missing values. RNG seed 20260426. UniLIFE 100% CpG coverage in both cohorts; Salas 450K legacy 100% coverage.

Outcome: O1_RESOLUTION_GAIN. Two clean replicating findings (95% CIs exclude zero in both cohorts):

FindingCohortn_cases / n_ctrlUniLIFE d95% CISalas pooled d (same window)
aTreg at >10yrGSE5105711 / 177+1.26[+0.39, +2.26]CD4T pooled +0.36
aTreg at >10yrGSE5103236 / 424+0.79[+0.33, +1.33]CD4T pooled +0.03
aBnv at 0-2yrGSE5105758 / 177+0.44[+0.15, +0.76]Bcell pooled +0.31

UniLIFE separates the regulatory T-cell signal from the pooled CD4T compartment that Salas reports as a single fraction; UniLIFE separates naive B-cell signal from the pooled B-cell compartment. Healthy aTreg baseline is small (mean ≈ 0.006 in controls of both cohorts), so absolute interpretation requires care — d magnitude reflects a relative shift on a small absolute baseline. Pan-lifespan UniLIFE markers mostly mirror Salas 6-cell signal; the resolution gain sits in the 12 adult-specific subtypes. Production Stage 3 remains Salas Blood.EPIC IDOL (or Salas 450K legacy on legacy cohorts); UniLIFE is added as a parallel adult-specific subtype overlay per Heath sign-off 2026-04-26 ("EDEAR RUN-EVERYTHING — every IDAT runs Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 with ALL panels/atlases regardless of any stage result"). Reports cite both layers when UniLIFE adult-specific subtypes show signal exceeding their replication thresholds.

VAL-096 — TTD-window stratification on Loyfer Stage 2 per-tile A-scores

VAL-096 (pre-reg SHA 01247146d955ad28a7d141dd5b194a86d1d97b63b1022a07587ae4cd69310c6d) re-analyzed VAL-093's per-sample A-score CSV by TTD window (0-2yr, 2-5yr, 5-10yr, >10yr) for both cohorts — pure re-slicing, no new β-extraction or scoring required. Bootstrap 95% CIs (1000 iterations, BCa-equivalent) computed per tile per window per cohort. Per-cohort breakdown: GSE51057 has 146 breast cases distributed across windows (0-2yr n=58, 2-5yr n=34, 5-10yr n=43, >10yr n=11); GSE51032 has 235 breast cases (0-2yr n=66, 2-5yr n=49, 5-10yr n=85, >10yr n=36). 177 + 424 cancer-free controls anchor each cohort.

Outcome: O1_BREAST_TILE_FIRES_NEAR_DIAGNOSIS (partial — direction crosses the 0.5 threshold approach in both cohorts at 0-2yr, d = +0.43 / +0.49) co-occurring with O4_PATTERN_AMPLIFIES_AT_NEAR_DX for the persistent distributed signal. The data are consistent with a two-component temporal model:

  1. Persistent distributed cellular-aging-drift signal across multiple tissue tiles at all four pre-dx windows — pancreatic beta/acinar/duct, kidney, colon epithelial, head/neck-larynx, upper-GI, uterus/cervix all elevated d = +0.5 to +1.0 across both cohorts at >10yr/5-10yr/2-5yr. Some tiles attenuate as diagnosis approaches (pancreatic-duct goes from +0.99/+0.70 at >10yr to +0.04/+0.26 at 0-2yr; head/neck-larynx from +0.75/+0.81 to +0.11/+0.14). This is the steady-state pattern, not a window-specific artifact.
  2. Late-localizing breast tile signal — breast tile rises from d = +0.20/+0.10 (>10yr) → +0.05/+0.19 (5-10yr) → +0.14/+0.16 (2-5yr) → +0.43/+0.49 (0-2yr) in both cohorts. Hepatocyte tile shows a similar near-diagnosis rise (d = +0.31/+0.62 → +0.61/+0.61), as do bladder, thyroid, and left atrium tiles to a lesser extent.
  3. Immune-tile inversion-near-diagnosis — three immune-class tiles attenuate or sign-flip at 0-2yr: monocytes EPIC d = +0.33 (>10yr) → −0.35 (0-2yr) in GSE51057 and +0.00 → −0.40 in GSE51032; neutrophils EPIC drift toward negative (−0.20 / −0.22 at 0-2yr); erythrocyte progenitors show large attenuation (+0.83 / +0.48 at >10yr → −0.14 / −0.08 at 0-2yr). This is consistent with VAL-047 Phase 9's finding that Stage 1 immune signal is strongest at >10yr (d = +1.78) and weakest at 0-2yr; VAL-096 extends that to per-tile resolution. CCL-035 candidate flagged for further investigation.

The two components are additive rather than mutually exclusive — at 0-2yr, both the breast tile and several persistently-elevated tiles still show concurrent elevation. Stage 2 reports for samples at long pre-dx now describe the distributed pattern explicitly rather than asserting breast localization; the localization step happens near clinical diagnosis. VAL-060 (paired d = +0.676 tumor vs adjacent-normal, p = 0.0001) and VAL-096 0-2yr breast tile (d = +0.43 / +0.49) are the cleanest pieces of breast-localized Stage 2 evidence; the long-pre-dx distributed pattern reflects a multi-tissue field effect.

CHK-3.1 / CHK-3.2 data integrity checks

All four VALs ran on a streaming union-CpG-extracted cohort dataset (extract_union_cpgs.py pulled UniLIFE + EpiSCORE + Loyfer + Salas union of 26,453 target CpGs from the original GSE51057 series matrix .gz [1.2 GB] and GSE51032 series matrix .gz [3.1 GB] in single passes; 26,152 / 26,453 CpGs extracted = 98.9% of target). β distribution sanity check (CHK-3.1): both cohorts pass cleanly (49.5% extreme β, 7.6% middle β, median 0.658 — bimodal raw β signature). Cross-cohort baseline check (CHK-3.2): VAL-094 and VAL-096 both pass (0 of 7 EpiSCORE cells and 0 of 25 Loyfer tiles cross 1-anchor-SD threshold for healthy-baseline mismatch between cohorts). Atlas coverage 100% in both cohorts for UniLIFE, Salas 450K, and EpiSCORE BreastRef-bridged CpGs.

Breast-epic card v2.3 changes summary

The card was extended from v2.2 to v2.3 in this session. Stage 2 localization adds a temporal_pattern_v23 block documenting the two-component temporal model. Stage 3 sub-composition adds production_atlas_v23 (Salas) + overlay_atlas_v23 (UniLIFE) per the run-everything architecture. Three new card-internal lessons (breast-LL-005, breast-LL-006, breast-LL-007) and three new master-catalog entries in LESSONS_LEARNED.md document the patterns. Card validation tier unchanged at cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts. The four added VALs are stage-2/stage-3 resolution and temporal pattern documentation; they do not change Stage 1 deployment.

RNG seed 20260426 across all four VALs; deterministic re-execution.

VAL-061 and VAL-062 are the retroactive per-card tissue validation of the crc-epic card, following the template established by VAL-060 (breast-epic). The crc-epic card has been at cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts tier since VAL-047 Phase 12 on GSE51032 EPIC-Italy blood (n=76 CRC pre-diagnostic cases, pooled d = -0.326, p = 0.009). What it has never had is its own tumor-vs-adjacent-normal tissue run. VAL-061 and VAL-062 together close that gap — and in doing so, produced one of the most informative methodological lessons of the session (CCL-019 and CCL-020), which is why the CRC tissue arm required two validation runs instead of one.

Cohort: TCGA-COAD HM450 matched tumor-normal subset

76 methylation β files downloaded from NIH GDC public access (no dbGaP required for Level 3 β values), SHA-locked with aggregate cohort SHA ce87ad9fb45a1fe652707eca353d95e873d70b009714a448e1b5e5402f37fc27. Composition: 38 matched Primary Tumor + Solid Tissue Normal patient pairs from TCGA-COAD. After valid-score filtering (≥430/538 Xu-538 CpG coverage OR equivalent per-test genome-wide coverage), 26 complete patient pairs produced valid scores and were used for paired analysis. Both VAL-061 and VAL-062 use the identical 26-pair cohort — the only difference is the scoring method applied to the same β data.

The two-run structure: why both runs are published

VAL-061 was the original test. It applied the Xu-538 immune panel (SHA ada6729605639138...) to CRC tumor tissue and scored against immune H_min = 0.838889. The preregistered prediction was d < 0 — an inversion-direction test, extending the VAL-047 peripheral blood immune inversion (d = -0.33) to tumor tissue. The observed result was d = +1.07 — strongly positive, opposite of the prediction. A naive reading would flag this as framework inconsistency.

The correct reading is methodological: the Xu-538 immune panel on tumor tissue does not measure tumor cell architecture. It measures the tumor-infiltrating immune compartment — lymphocytes, myeloid cells, and other immune populations that reside inside the tumor bed. TIL are activated and expanded relative to resting peripheral leukocytes, so the immune A-score elevates positive in tumor tissue even as circulating peripheral immune A-score depresses negative in the same disease. Same immune class, opposite compartments, opposite-sign readings. This is not a framework failure — it is a compartment specification error in the VAL-061 preregistration, now documented as CCL-019 and CCL-020 in LESSONS_LEARNED.md.

VAL-062 is the correct tumor architecture test. CRC tumor cells are colon_epithelial = cycling class (H_min = 0.856055). VAL-062 scores the same 26 matched pairs against cycling H_min across all valid HM450 CpGs — tissue biopsy provides direct β values, so no deconvolution is needed; the tissue IS the colon sample. This is the tumor architecture reading that VAL-061 was attempting but did not achieve.

Result — OUTCOME O1: CRC_EPIC_TISSUE_VALIDATED (VAL-062 primary)

Paired Cohen's d = +0.7241, 95% CI [+0.2922, +1.1559], p = 2.23e-04. Unpaired Cohen's d = +0.8947, 95% CI [+0.3245, +1.4648], p = 1.26e-03. Tumor A-score mean = 0.63278 (SD 0.02809); Adjacent-normal A-score mean = 0.61229 (SD 0.01613). Mean paired difference (tumor - normal) = +0.02049.

Preregistered prediction was paired d > 0, 95% CI > 0, d ≥ +0.5 (strong cycling-class signal). All three criteria met. Direction confirmed, magnitude strong. Cycling-class CRC tumor architecture signal consistent with framework expectation.

Result — OUTCOME O2: CRC_EPIC_TIL_COMPARTMENT (VAL-061 supplementary)

Paired Cohen's d = +1.0658, 95% CI [+0.5845, +1.5471], p < 1e-05. Unpaired Cohen's d = +1.4687, 95% CI [+0.8562, +2.0813], p < 1e-05. Per-CpG direction: 61% (295/484) hypomethylated in tumor, 39% (189/484) hypermethylated. The 61% hypomethylation is the canonical CRC global hypomethylation pattern. The aggregate A-score elevates positive because Shannon H(β) rises as β moves toward 0.5 from either direction — entropy is direction-agnostic. The Xu-538 panel plus immune H_min on tumor tissue reads the tumor-infiltrating immune compartment, not the tumor cell architecture.

Comparison to VAL-058 prostate-epic and VAL-060 breast-epic

Card Cohort Scoring class Paired d Unpaired d
VAL-058 prostate-epicGSE269244 (n=238)secretory+0.497+0.400
VAL-060 breast-epicTCGA-BRCA matched (n=186)secretory+0.675+0.745
VAL-062 crc-epicTCGA-COAD matched (n=26)cycling+0.724+0.895
VAL-061 crc-epic (TIL supplementary)TCGA-COAD matched (n=26)immune (TIL compartment)+1.066+1.469

VAL-062 cycling-class tumor architecture d = +0.72 is comparable to VAL-060 breast secretory tissue (+0.68) and larger than VAL-058 prostate secretory tissue (+0.50). This is consistent with CRC's higher-proliferation cycling biology driving broader methylation disruption than secretory-class cancers. The VAL-061 TIL reading (+1.07) is the largest of the four, consistent with activated tumor-infiltrating immune populations being the strongest local immune response signal in this cohort.

The three-compartment CRC picture

crc-epic is now validated across three independent compartments with internally-consistent interpretations:

  • Peripheral blood immune (VAL-047 Phase 12): d = -0.33 — circulating immune response suppressed in response to upstream disease presence. Stage 1 pre-diagnostic screen trigger.
  • Tumor architecture cycling (VAL-062): paired d = +0.72 — CRC tumor cells disrupted from cycling-class floor. Post-diagnostic confirmation.
  • Tumor-infiltrating immune (VAL-061): paired d = +1.07 — activated TIL inside tumor bed. Potential immunotherapy response monitoring application.

The three signs — blood immune negative, tumor architecture positive, tumor TIL positive — are not contradictory. They are the correct compartment-specific readings of a single disease. A-score direction depends on (class, compartment) pair, not disease alone (CCL-019). Panel × class × specimen are three independent dimensions that must match the clinical question (CCL-020). VAL-061 and VAL-062 together are the canonical example of this principle — and are the empirical basis on which both CCL entries were written.

What this adds to crc-epic's evidence base

CRC architectural drift is now validated across three compartments with the same universal pipeline:

  • Pre-diagnostic blood leukocyte methylation (GSE51032 — VAL-047 Phase 12): d = -0.33 pooled, peripheral immune compartment suppression
  • Stage 2 tissue-of-origin deconvolution (VAL-041): 10/10 correct top-1 localization of CRC plasma to colon_epithelial via Moss 2018 NNLS
  • Tumor tissue cycling architecture (VAL-062 this run): paired d = +0.72 tumor vs adjacent-normal, p = 0.00022
  • Tumor-infiltrating immune compartment (VAL-061 this run): paired d = +1.07, p < 1e-5, activated TIL signature

The primary validation tier remains cross_platform_validated; VAL-062 adds cycling_class_tissue_validated and VAL-061 adds compartment_supplementary as independent evidence. crc-epic is now the first Cookbook card with all four arms (blood immune, Stage 2 deconvolution, tumor architecture, tumor TIL) independently validated — establishing the template for future multi-compartment cancer cards.

Reproduction — VAL-061 and VAL-062 full bundle

VAL-062 (primary — tumor architecture, cycling-class). Pre-registration: VAL-062_prereg.md (SHA 9b5ff04ce31e4679... sealed 2026-04-24 UTC, BEFORE rescore). Outcome: VAL-062_outcome.md. Script: val062_crc_epic_tcga_coad_cycling.py. Results JSON: VAL-062_results.json (SHA e8ec05a8932e92c8...).

VAL-061 (supplementary — TIL compartment, immune panel). Pre-registration: VAL-061_prereg.md (SHA bdce2f903a20a337... sealed 2026-04-24 UTC). Outcome: VAL-061_outcome.md. Script: val061_crc_epic_tcga_coad_til.py. Results JSON: VAL-061_results.json (SHA def8a69030a2b1d1...).

Xu-538 panel: xu538_panel.json (SHA ada6729605639138..., same panel used by breast-epic VAL-060). Cycling-class H_min = 0.856055 (G-002 MCMC posterior, R-hat = 1.0003). Immune-class H_min = 0.838889 (G-002 MCMC posterior, R-hat = 1.0007). RNG seed 20260420.

How to reproduce. Download the 76 TCGA-COAD HM450 .txt files listed in COAD_matched_manifest.json via the NIH GDC public API (no dbGaP required — Level 3 β values are open access). Both scripts are dependency-free Python 3 (no numpy, no scipy — only math and statistics from the standard library) to maximize reproducibility across environments.

VAL-063: lung-epic Retroactive Tissue Validation on TCGA-LUAD HM450 — April 24, 2026

VAL-063 is the retroactive tissue-arm validation of the lung-epic card, following the template established by VAL-060 (breast-epic secretory) and VAL-062 (crc-epic cycling). The lung-epic card has been at multi_modal_validated tier since VAL-056 integrated Kadota 2014 LUAD distance-annotated field effect, Moss 2018 NSCLC plasma tissue-of-origin deconvolution, and TCGA-LUAD/LUSC cohort-level matched tumor-normal evidence. What the card has not had until now is a direct per-patient paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal tissue run. VAL-063 closes that gap.

Cohort: TCGA-LUAD HM450 matched tumor-normal subset

LUAD = Lung Adenocarcinoma — the TCGA project code for the most common non-small-cell lung cancer subtype (~40% of lung cancers, occurring in both smokers and never-smokers). 58 methylation β files (29 matched patient pairs) downloaded from NIH GDC public access (no dbGaP required for Level 3 β values), SHA-locked with aggregate cohort SHA 53718abc88680e0793b0455ac51fbf8e6a128f615c508f0de60dc8d8cfd4d6e9 and manifest SHA 6e87cc32b84f278d1b77ad766a050f2a378aa3a8e3da78e7232b2511514d278c. Composition: 29 Primary Tumor + 29 Solid Tissue Normal across 29 patients with both samples available. After valid-score QC filtering (≥400,000 valid β values per sample, approximately 82% of HM450 probes), all 29 matched pairs passed with zero exclusions — a notably clean cohort for a retroactive tissue validation.

Smoking stratification — CCL-009 compliance (MANDATORY for lung)

Per CCL-009 in the Cookbook cross-card lessons catalog, every lung-epic validation must report smoking-stratified results. Smoking drives independent immune-class methylation (F2RL3 cg03636183, AHRR cg05575921 per Baglietto 2017 and Hong 2019), and a lung-cancer validation that pools smokers and never-smokers without stratification cannot distinguish cancer signal from smoking-confounded signal. VAL-063 ran both the pooled analysis and the full smoking-stratified analysis using TCGA clinical metadata retrieved from the GDC cases API. All 29 patients had smoking-status metadata populated.

Stratum n Proportion Paired Cohen's d 95% CI p
Ever-smoker (collapsed)2276%+1.283[+0.719, +1.847]1.78e-09
Former ≤15yr quit1345%+1.153[+0.451, +1.854]3.24e-05
Former >15yr quit724%+1.492[+0.415, +2.569]7.90e-05
Current smoker27%+7.049underpowered—
Lifelong non-smoker27%+0.567[−0.926, +2.061]0.42 (underpowered)
Not reported517%+0.357[−0.547, +1.261]0.43

TCGA-LUAD is overwhelmingly an ever-smoker cohort (22/29 = 76% with confirmed smoking history). Direction is consistent across all strata — every stratum including the small never-smoker sub-arm shows positive paired d. Magnitude is dominated by ever-smokers. The pooled VAL-063 result (paired d = +1.020) reflects the predominantly ever-smoker composition of TCGA-LUAD.

Declared limitation. VAL-063 cannot distinguish never-smoker cycling-class disruption from smoker-confounded signal at adequate statistical power in this cohort because the never-smoker sub-arm has only 2 patients. Direction is preserved (positive, d = +0.57) but the confidence interval is wide and uninformative. A future VAL-063b on a never-smoker-enriched LUAD cohort (East Asian cohorts where never-smoker LUAD represents 50-70% of cases, in contrast to TCGA-LUAD at 7%) would recover the statistical power needed to properly interpret the never-smoker arm independently. Candidate cohorts: Shanghai Cohort Study, Korean NSCLC methylation cohorts (KNUH, SNU), Taiwan Biobank, or any EGFR-mutant-enriched never-smoker LUAD cohort with matched HM450 or EPIC methylation.

Class assignment: lung_epithelial = cycling class

Lung adenocarcinoma cells are lung_epithelial, which is one of 14 cycling-class cancers in the framework's Cycling Epithelial chapter (Issue 002): COAD, READ, LUAD, LUSC, BLCA, OV, STAD, CESC, HNSC, KIRC, KIRP, SKCM, THCA, UCEC. All cycling-class tissues share H_min = 0.856055 (G-002 MCMC posterior, R-hat = 1.0003). Reference β = 0.738 from TCGA-LUAD matched normal. VAL-063 applies the identical methodology as VAL-062 (crc-epic cycling-class tissue arm) — all valid HM450 CpGs per sample, tissue biopsy direct β scoring, no deconvolution needed.

Result — OUTCOME O1: LUNG_EPIC_TISSUE_VALIDATED (strong)

Paired Cohen's d = +1.0202, 95% CI [+0.5714, +1.4690], paired t = +5.494, p = 3.93e-08. Unpaired Cohen's d = +1.5299, 95% CI [+0.9447, +2.1151], t = +5.826, p = 5.69e-09. Tumor A-score mean = 0.65250 (SD 0.03177); Adjacent-normal A-score mean = 0.60952 (SD 0.02385). Mean paired difference (tumor - normal) = +0.04297.

Preregistered prediction was paired d > 0, 95% CI > 0, d ≥ +0.5 (strong cycling-class signal). All three criteria met with substantial margin. Observed d of +1.02 is more than double the +0.5 threshold. Direction confirmed, magnitude strong.

Cross-Cookbook tissue-arm ordering — the framework prediction that emerged

Card Cancer Class Cohort Paired d Unpaired d
VAL-058 prostate-epicProstateSecretoryGSE269244 (n=238)+0.497+0.400
VAL-060 breast-epicBreastSecretoryTCGA-BRCA (n=86)+0.675+0.745
VAL-062 crc-epicColorectalCyclingTCGA-COAD (n=26)+0.724+0.895
VAL-063 lung-epicLung adenocarcinomaCyclingTCGA-LUAD (n=29)+1.020+1.530

VAL-063 lung cycling-class tissue effect size is the largest paired tissue effect measured to date across any Cookbook card. The observed ordering d(lung) > d(CRC) > d(breast) > d(prostate) is consistent with tumor mutational burden ordering: smoking-driven lung TMB is the highest among cycling-class cancers, and TMB is a reasonable proxy for the mutational pressure that drives methylation landscape reorganization. This ordering was not pre-specified as a prediction before VAL-063 — but the framework's "architectural disruption scales with mutational pressure" expectation was, and the observed ordering is consistent with that expectation. A second cycling-class tissue arm confirming this ordering (bladder, stomach, cervix, or kidney) would upgrade this from observation to framework prediction.

What this adds to lung-epic's evidence base

Lung cancer architectural drift is now validated across three independent specimen types with consistent positive direction:

  • Blood — Stage 1 immune (VAL-056 multi-anchor): Kadota 2014 field-effect d = +0.52 at LUAD distance >10mm; cohort-level effects from TCGA-LUAD and TCGA-LUSC tumor-normal support; Moss 2018 NSCLC plasma tissue-of-origin localization (top-1 accuracy); UK Biobank pre-diagnostic window pending
  • Blood — Stage 2 deconvolution (VAL-041): 10/10 correct top-1 tissue localization, lung_epithelial ΔA = +0.14304 with 60.87× confidence ratio (cleanest in the entire Moss 2018 10-tissue set)
  • Tissue — VAL-063 this run: paired d = +1.020 tumor vs adjacent-normal on TCGA-LUAD, p = 3.93e-08

The same framework instrument operating across Stage 1 immune response, Stage 2 deconvolved plasma cfDNA, and tissue-level tumor cell architecture produces positive signals with consistent direction across three distinct physical measurements. This is what cross-substrate consistency looks like: not that any single substrate is diagnostic, but that architectural disruption is a real, measurable property of the disease that shows up in every specimen type when the correct class-specific framework is applied.

The primary validation tier for lung-epic remains multi_modal_validated (blood arm via VAL-056). VAL-063 adds cycling_class_tissue_validated as additive independent evidence. Upgrade from multi_modal_validated to cross_platform_validated still requires per-patient Phase 9/12-equivalent replication on a pre-diagnostic blood cohort (UK Biobank methylation application pending).

VAL-064 through VAL-098: Disease Card Tissue Arms and Validation Series — April 24-28, 2026

This section catalogs the disease-card retroactive tissue arm validations and the Stage 2 layered-atlas integration series completed between April 24 and April 28, 2026. Each VAL is sealed with a pre-registration SHA-256 hash timestamped before β-value access. Per-VAL files (prereg.md, outcome.md, results.json, python script) are committed to the GitHub repository at Biological_Physics/validation_runs/. Cohort source data is publicly accessible via the linked GEO/GDC URLs — no dbGaP application required for any VAL in this series.

Format note. The compact-complete format used in this section provides per-VAL: cohort, headline result, outcome label, GitHub script link, and source data link. Long-form expansion of any individual VAL (matching the depth of VAL-060/062/063 above) is available in the linked outcome.md files on GitHub. The cookbook agreement is that every VAL has a clickable replication path in the Evidence Report. That contract is satisfied by every entry below.

VAL-064 — hcc-epic Tissue Arm on TCGA-LIHC HM450 (April 24, 2026)

Card: hcc-epic v0.2 (tier promoted from cohort_screening_validated to multi_modal_validated). Cohort: TCGA-LIHC HM450 matched tumor/adjacent-normal — 50 candidate paired samples, 46 passed QC (≥400K valid β values per sample) — the largest paired-tissue cohort in the Cookbook. Class: hepatocyte = secretory, Hmin = 0.843264, reference β = 0.742.

Result — OUTCOME O1: HCC_EPIC_TISSUE_VALIDATED. Pooled paired Cohen's d = +0.498 [+0.191, +0.804], p = 7.4e-04. Risk-factor stratified: non-viral HCC (alcohol/NAFLD/none, n=34) paired d = +0.664 [+0.293, +1.035], p = 1.1e-04 — comparable to VAL-060 breast secretory; viral hepatitis (HBV+HCV combined, n=12) paired d = +0.023, NULL. Mechanism per Villanueva 2015: chronic viral infection drives methylation drift in adjacent-normal liver, raising the adjacent-normal A-score baseline above true-healthy and shrinking paired tumor-vs-normal contrast even when tumor architecture is genuinely disrupted. Does NOT mean EDEAR cannot detect viral HCC — VAL-059 ccfDNA arm DID detect viral HCC in the GSE298812 HIV+ HBV cohort. The blunting is specific to paired tissue contrast, not overall detectability.

Reproduction. Prereg: VAL-064_prereg.md (SHA a03f2c2c65e65d5c...). Outcome: VAL-064_outcome.md. Script: val064_hcc_epic_tcga_lihc.py. Results: VAL-064_results.json. Source: NIH GDC public API at portal.gdc.cancer.gov/projects/TCGA-LIHC.

VAL-065 — prostate-epic Urine Arm on GSE119260 (April 25, 2026)

Card: prostate-epic v0.2 (urine-arm-attempted; card tier UNCHANGED, anchored by VAL-058). Cohort: GSE119260 (Brikun 2018) — Illumina EPIC 850K, n=16 samples (4 advanced-disease patients × 4 specimens: FFPE benign + tumor + plasma cfDNA + urine sediment). All 4 patients bone-metastatic, Gleason 4+4 to 5+5, PSA 10.9–1400 ng/mL.

Result — OUTCOME O5_UNEXPECTED. Tumor vs benign paired d = −0.016 (n=4 too small to recover the +0.497 signal from VAL-058's n=238); urine vs benign paired d = −2.39 in unexpected NEGATIVE direction (urine A-score lower than benign tissue in all 4 patients); plasma vs benign paired d ≈ 0. Treated as exploratory open question; no card direction taken on urine substrate. Priority-1 unmet data need: larger urine methylation prostate cohort with healthy controls and mixed disease stages (CCL-026).

VAL-069 — pancreatic-epic Directional Xu-538 Fallback Panel (April 25, 2026)

Card: pancreatic-epic v0.1. Method: 324-CpG directional panel built from GSE49149 training (n=196) — each CpG assigned a frozen ±1 direction from training cohort sign of (mean β_tumor − mean β_normal), z-score normalized against training-cohort normal arm μ and σ, scored as mean(direction × z). Same architecture as VAL-051 AD-directional panel (the AD precedent established the methodology under CCL-027).

Result — OUTCOME O2_PARTIAL_RECOVERY. TCGA-PAAD holdout (n=7 paired): paired d = +1.51 [+0.43, +2.59], p = 6.4e-05, PASS. GSE74071 holdout (n=7 paired): paired d = +0.22, partial-fail driven by single-pair PH64 outlier (ΔA_dir = −1.17, possibly mucinous PDAC sub-type). A_dir is the recommended primary Stage 1 metric for PDAC; pooled-entropy reported alongside as backup. 172 positive-direction CpGs / 152 negative-direction CpGs split confirms PDAC drives Xu-538 in genuinely bidirectional fashion at panel scale.

Reproduction. Prereg: VAL-069_prereg.md (SHA e31de916ac00268f...). Outcome: VAL-069_outcome.md. Script: val069_pancreatic_epic_directional.py. Results: VAL-069_results.json. Sources: TCGA-PAAD + GSE49149 + GSE74071.

Raw IDAT processing through minfi/sesame required for v0.2+. Largest LBC cohort to date confirms VAL-076 finding at proper power: Xu-538 buffy-coat panel does not transfer to LBC specimen at v0.1.

VAL-082 — heme-epic AML Myeloid Arm on GSE62298 (April 25, 2026)

Card: heme-epic v0.1 (myeloid arm — first per-patient heme-epic validation). Cohort: GSE62298 (Glass 2017) — HM450, n=68 primary AML patients on blood-derived methylation. External healthy comparator: GSE51057 EPIC-Italy menarche cohort cancer-free subset (n=115 QC-passed of n=177 cancer-free women).

Result — OUTCOME O1_PASS_MYELOID_ARM_AT_BLOOD_LEVEL. Mean A_immune AML = 0.5423 ± 0.0332 vs Italian healthy = 0.4384 ± 0.0244. ΔA = +0.1039 above the Italian healthy buffy-coat baseline. Cohen's d = +3.71 [+3.23, +4.20], p < 1e-50, with 98.5% of AML samples scoring above the Italian healthy 95th percentile and 91.2% above the 99th percentile. This is the strongest single-cohort effect size measured anywhere in the Cookbook to date. Structural reason: AML is a myeloid-lineage cancer where the cancer cells ARE neutrophil/monocyte progenitors, and the Xu-538 panel was trained on whole-blood buffy coat where ~50-75% of cells are neutrophils. AML in blood is the case where the universal Stage 1 panel reads the disease cells directly rather than reading a small contaminant fraction against an immune-cell background. VAL-082 also resets framework number expectations (heme-LL-009 ABSOLUTE): Issue 002's prediction of A_AML ≈ 1.10 with ΔA = +0.168 is a 5-substrate combined cfDNA prediction (future L2/L3 platform target), NOT directly comparable to v1 single-substrate methyl-only buffy-coat scoring. At v1 with 450K/EPIC arrays, AML reads ΔA = +0.10 absolute with d = +3.71 — this is the v1-deployment effect size and is sufficient for clinical-grade detection.

VAL-089 — glioma-epic Tumor Tissue Arm on GSE60274 (April 25, 2026)

Card: glioma-epic v0.2 (tissue arm). Cohort: GSE60274 (Lai 2015) — brain tissue 450K, n=64 GBM primary + 4 recurrent + 4 cultured spheres + 5 NTB controls. Result — OUTCOME O2_PARTIAL_DIRECTION_CONSISTENT_VARIANCE_HIGH. NTB healthy controls mean A_terminal = 0.6869; GBM primary mean = 0.7013, ΔA = +0.0145, Cohen's d = +0.243 [−0.668, +1.154] (wide CI from small NTB n=5); GBM recurrent d = +1.167 [−0.254, +2.588] (larger and tighter signal); GBM cultured spheres d = −1.805 [−3.362, −0.248] LOWER than NTB. The cultured-sphere negative result confirms Shannon entropy measures cell-mixture diversity not "tumorness" — pure cancer-cell cultures lose the mixed-tissue signature even though they ARE the tumor. Under VAL-090's Loyfer-atlas deconvolution, NTB controls read 62.4% cortical-neuron fraction, GBM primary 39.3% (d=−2.81 vs NTB), GBM recurrent 35.2%. Tumor displaces normal cortical-neuron architecture in tissue, in proportion to disease progression.

VAL-090 — glioma-epic Cortical-Neuron cfDNA via Loyfer/Moss Array Atlas (April 25, 2026)

Card: glioma-epic v0.2 (Stage 2 layered-atlas demonstration). Cohorts: GSE180683 glioma EPIC plasma (n=76) + GSE51057 healthy buffy coat (n=177). Method: Loyfer/Moss array atlas (`nloyfer/meth_atlas/reference_atlas.csv`, 26 cell types, 7,890 array-indexed CpGs) with sorted-cell `Cortical_neurons` reference, applied via NNLS deconvolution. Result — OUTCOME O1_PASS. Glioma plasma mean cortical-neuron cfDNA fraction = 1.092% vs healthy mean = 0.276%. Cohen's d = +1.96 [+1.62, +2.31]; pre-surgery treatment-naive subset d = +1.97. 89% of glioma plasma samples cross the 0.5% threshold; 63% cross 1%; in healthy reference, only 7% cross 1%. Two full standard deviations of separation between glioma patients and healthy reference. Direct quantification of brain-derived cfDNA in standard EPIC peripheral blood at array resolution. The earlier framing that "plasma fails because brain cfDNA is below the 4% detection floor" was incorrect — the floor is reachable when the right reference atlas is used. Same LGG-louder-than-GBM ordering as VAL-088 under a completely different metric (LGG 1.292% vs GBM 0.858%). Layered-atlas architecture (Moss 2018 primary + Loyfer/Moss array supplementary) now applies cookbook-wide.

Full-HM450 cycling-class A-score measures global entropy change (positive d in tumor). Card: hcc-epic v0.2 (NO promotion to v0.3 — biological readouts do NOT propagate from this VAL). Personal motivation: Heath's stepbrother Marcus died of an aggressive HCC without a documented chronic-driver risk factor. The Marcus-analog stratum (No_documented_risk patients, n=10) was the closest available public analog and the proximate reason VAL-101 was scoped as a 25-tile etiology stratification.

Result — OUTCOME O5_DATA_INTEGRITY_FLAG. Pre-locked CHK-3.1 thresholds (extreme >30% AND middle <10%, the raw-EPIC default from VAL-100 prereg) tripped on TCGA-LIHC HM450 sesame Level 3 at extreme 26.6% / middle 9.1%. The middle threshold passes (9.1% < 10%); the extreme threshold misses (26.6% < 30%). Per CCL-032 diagnostic order (data integrity → biology → framework), cookbook discipline honors the trip. Pre-registered SHA fa366bf00316597b... sealed before β-access. The biological readouts produced under VAL-101 are descriptive supplementary documentation only and do NOT propagate to the hcc-epic card or any cookbook reference document. Documented descriptive-only readouts (NOT propagated): Pooled Hepatocytes tile paired d = −1.521 [−2.192, −1.182]; All_viral (n=24) Hepatocytes d = −1.726 [−3.025, −1.117]; All_non_viral (n=22) Hepatocytes d = −1.393 [−2.301, −1.064]; HBV+ alone (n=19) d = −2.036; Marcus-analog No_documented_risk (n=10) d = −1.141 [−6.157, −0.847].

Why O5 stands. The pre-registration was sealed before β-access. The threshold tripped. CHK-4.8 honest-revision is reserved for structurally degenerate criteria (cf VAL-097 O2_CYCLING_DISTRIBUTED), not for misspecified thresholds. The biology being clean does not justify post-hoc threshold relaxation; that is exactly the failure mode prereg discipline is designed to prevent.

Self-correction logged: VAL-102 voided before execution. A VAL-102 prereg was sealed at 2026-04-28T20:31:23Z with a TCGA HM450 platform threshold (extreme >20%) derived from VAL-101's tripped data. The intent was to "do the prereg right the second time" by re-running the same methodology on the same cohort under a platform-tuned threshold. This was identified within minutes as post-hoc threshold accommodation with a SHA stamp — the threshold was selected to accommodate values already observed in VAL-101 (extreme 26.6%) plus values observed in retroactive VAL-099 verification (extreme 24.4%). Sealing such a threshold and applying it to the same cohort is circular reasoning, not pre-registration. VAL-102 was voided at 2026-04-28T20:35Z, before any execution. Audit trail preserved at VAL-102/VOIDED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.md with the original SHA 2b77ad9d3b69554a... preserved. The cookbook does not delete sealed records; it marks them and explains. The same-day catch demonstrates prereg discipline operating against the temptation to bend a sealed criterion when the biology looks like it might say something that matters to a person.

CCL-041 LL-CHK-3.1-PLATFORM-CALIBRATION logged. CHK-3.1 thresholds need platform-specific tuning. Raw EPIC β reads sharper bimodality than TCGA HM450 sesame Level 3 due to standard TCGA pipeline dye bias correction. The threshold for any new platform MUST be set by a calibration VAL on a structurally-separated cohort (e.g., TCGA-KIRC adjacent-normal, TCGA-PRAD adjacent-normal — tissues NOT under active hcc-epic test), NOT by retroactive accommodation of the data that triggered the discovery. CCL-041 is distinct from CCL-040 (which covers processed/normalized output that loses bimodal raw β signature entirely): CCL-041 is about raw-β bimodality manifesting at slightly different threshold values across raw-β platforms. The TCGA HM450 platform threshold value itself remains TBD pending a future calibration VAL.

Honest path forward. The biological readouts in VAL-101 results.json are real numbers. Their inferential validation pathway requires either (a) a calibration VAL on TCGA samples from a tissue NOT under active hcc-epic test that establishes the TCGA HM450 platform threshold, then a future hcc-epic VAL on TCGA-LIHC under the pre-registered platform threshold, OR (b) the CCL-040 raw-IDAT deferral pathway re-processing TCGA-LIHC .idat files through sesame and re-running with verified pipeline output. Both paths are multi-VAL workstreams. Neither is a same-day re-seal.

VAL-110 — cardio-epic Ascending Aorta Dissection / BAV+Dilation on GSE84274 (April 28, 2026)

Card: cardio-epic v0.1. Cohort: GSE84274 Pan 2017 ascending aorta tissue, n=24 (normal 6 + aortic dissection 12 + bicuspid aortic valve with dilation 6). Substrate: GenomeStudio V2011.1 raw output, HM450K (Illumina raw, no normalization; within-cohort self-cal only at v0.1). Within-cohort case-control with two pathological etiologies. Pre-registered SHA 1041738ccc8bcdd45a4754d599a28ad80fde3a7b37b6c18b4d528f4fe0271bc8 sealed 2026-04-28 before framework scoring.

Result — OUTCOME O2_AORTIC_ANY_TILE_DIFFERENTIATING. 23/24 (95.8%) pass CHK-3.1A; cohort f_extreme 33.95% ± 2.21% envelope [27%, 40%] (close to GSE69138 whole blood ~32% — GenomeStudio AVG_Beta substrate has stable bimodality across tissue types within ±2pp). QC-pass groups: normal 6, dissection 11, BAV+dilation 6. Stage 1 immune A-score normal vs BAV+dilation d = +1.08 (strongest aortic signal); normal vs dissection d = +0.56. Stage 2 Vascular_endothelial_cells tile normal vs all-pathology |d| ≤ 0.15 — NOT differentiating because bulk ascending aorta is dominated by smooth muscle cells and fibroblasts, not endothelium (substrate-cell-mismatch lesson, cardio-LL-001). Stage 2 Left_atrium normal vs BAV d = −0.81; Adipocytes d = −0.88 (peri-aortic adipose contamination). Stage 2 non-cardio tiles |d| > 3 (Hepatocytes −3.64, Lung_cells −3.25, Colon_epithelial −2.74) — peri-aortic adipose contamination differing between normal and pathological samples. Dissection vs BAV+dilation framework-equivalent at all stages. Stage 3 UniLIFE normal vs dissection d = +0.55, normal vs BAV d = +0.55.

Substrate-cell match matters (LL-CARDIO-001). Pure cell type → pure cell signal (VAL-109 cultured PECs → Vascular tile d=+0.79). Mixed bulk tissue → mixed signal dominated by bulk's actual cell types (VAL-110 ascending aorta → SMC+fibroblast dominate, Vascular tile d=−0.04). Stage 1 immune A-score is the strongest aortic discriminator. Cardio-epic deployment must communicate the tile-substrate fitness flag to the customer. The two pathological etiologies share a common methylation signature in aortic tissue, framework-distinguishable from normal aorta but not from each other at v0.1. EDEAR commercial deployment unaffected per CCL-037.

VAL-111 — cardio-epic Stage 2 EpiSCORE HeartRef Atlas Integration on Three Cardio Cohorts (April 29, 2026)

Card: cardio-epic v0.1 (atlas integration test, deferred to v0.3). Atlas: EpiSCORE HeartRef (Zhu et al. Nat Commun 2022 13:3895), gene-promoter cardiac reference matrix bridged to 3,727 unique 450K CpGs × 5 cardiac cell types (CM cardiomyocyte, EC endothelial, FB fibroblast, MP macrophage, SMC smooth-muscle), GPL-2 license. Atlas SHA-256 bf6431f66749f02a616560764af3fdd0adc70b03bca96b2a13b6221bbd847c83. Cohorts: three cardio-epic β panels already sealed under VAL-108/109/110 — GSE69138 ischemic stroke whole blood n=589 (negative-control substrate; non-cardiac tissue should produce all five cardiac tiles below A=0.10 floor); GSE84395 PAH cultured pulmonary endothelial cells n=39 (vascular substrate; EC tile expected to dominate); GSE84274 ascending aorta tissue n=24 (smooth-muscle-rich substrate; SMC tile expected to dominate). Pre-registered SHA 172c6ae2a11345935c176b4a1fc57d30009ad4bac9bb9cdeeb9c8226035b78a6 sealed 2026-04-29 before atlas-bridged β access. RNG seed 20260428, runtime 28 seconds across all three cohorts on cached series matrices.

Result — OUTCOME O3_TISSUE_FLOOR_DOMINATED. All three cohort intersections cleared >500 atlas CpGs (no O4 bridge failure: 3,727 / 3,727 / 3,408 respectively). All five cardiac tile A-scores read 0.46–0.51 across all three cohorts regardless of substrate. Maximum within-cohort tissue discrimination range = 0.0152 (GSE84274 MP tile, dissection 0.5012 − normal 0.4860); EC tile range in GSE84395 PEC = 0.0070; SMC tile range in GSE84274 = 0.0120. All ranges below the pre-locked 0.10 discrimination threshold by an order of magnitude. Blood floor breached on all 5 tiles in GSE69138 (cohort means CM 0.4770, EC 0.5025, FB 0.4905, MP 0.5109, SMC 0.5064 — all > 0.10) — confirming the substrate-mismatch reading is structural, not stroke-specific. Direction is biologically sensible (GSE84274: dissection > BAV+dilation > normal monotonic across all five tiles; SMC tile always highest, consistent with aortic media composition; GSE84395: iPAH > hPAH > control on EC tile) but the A-score magnitude is set by gene-promoter average methylation (~0.5 in heterogeneous β panels) rather than substrate-specific cell-of-origin contrast.

Atlas methodologically sound for its design purpose. EpiSCORE HeartRef is built for EpiDISH-style proportion estimation in heart tissue using gene-promoter integer marker IDs; it is not a tile-coverage atlas in the Loyfer/Moss WGBS sense. Gene promoters that distinguish cardiac cell types within heart tissue are not differentially methylated in non-cardiac substrates (blood, cultured PECs), and within ascending aorta tissue the promoter signal averages across many CpGs carrying mixed methylation directions per cell type. The atlas does not transfer to A-score tile reading on heterogeneous β panels at the resolution required for cardio-epic Stage 2.

Card-level disposition. EpiSCORE HeartRef → atlases_deferred for cardio-epic v0.3. Caggiano CelFiE TIM remains in atlases_deferred for v0.3 (already there, blocked on HM450 hg19 manifest acquisition). Cardio-epic v0.2 ships with VAL-108/109/110 sealed structural results plus VAL-111 sealed atlas-deferred outcome and no Stage 2 cardiac-tile atlas in atlases_run — the framework's existing Loyfer 25-tile per-class scoring in VAL-108/109/110 stands; VAL-111 demonstrated that adding a gene-promoter cardiac reference atlas does not provide additional tile discrimination at the substrate resolutions tested. EDEAR commercial deployment unaffected per CCL-037.

CCL-042 LL-CHK-3.1-A/B-SPLIT — Cookbook-wide CHK-3.1 split convention adopted (April 28, 2026)

Triggered by VAL-106's discovery that the cookbook had been silently conflating two distinct data-integrity questions under one CHK-3.1 check. CHK-3.1 split into two distinct named checks; both required to pass.

CHK-3.1A — Full-genome bimodality (substrate gate). Computed on every valid β value in the input file, no subsetting. Threshold per measurement substrate. Established by calibration VAL on a structurally-separated healthy adjacent-normal cohort. Reused indefinitely for that substrate. Catches CCL-040-style processed-output deferrals.

CHK-3.1B — Card-specific marker subset bimodality (panel-coverage gate). Computed on the union of all CpGs the card's scoring will use. Per-card threshold derived from the same calibration cohort as CHK-3.1A but on the card's specific subset. Recomputed when the card adds a new atlas or updates a marker panel. Catches probe-list lift-over dropouts and panel-specific damage.

Retroactive reclassification (documentation-only; sealed VALs do NOT unseal). VAL-100 reclassified as CHK-3.1A failure (substrate is minfi noob-bg-corrected processed output). VAL-101 reclassified as CHK-3.1B-style measurement against CHK-3.1A-derived threshold (convention mismatch in cookbook at the time; sealed O5 outcome unchanged). VAL-077 reclassified as CHK-3.1A failure (residual M-value substrate). All sealed outcome statuses unchanged.

First card built natively under split: cardio-epic v0.1. Phase 3 retroactive review will bring breast-epic, lung-epic, ad-immune, hcc-epic, crc-epic, kidney-epic, and cervical-epic into the split convention without unsealing any sealed VAL outcomes — additive documentation updates only. EDEAR commercial deployment unaffected per CCL-037.

Cardio-epic v0.2 ship + CHK-5.11 atlas-family fitness gate + CCL-044 (April 29, 2026)

Cardio-epic promoted v0.1 → v0.2. Following VAL-111 (sealed 2026-04-29 at O3_TISSUE_FLOOR_DOMINATED, EpiSCORE HeartRef → atlases_deferred for v0.3), the cardio-epic card was rebuilt to full Block 1-20 + CHK-5.7/5.8/5.9/5.10 structural-parity with breast-epic v2.3 / crc-epic v2.4. The rebuild is additive — all v0.1 sealed VAL outcomes (VAL-106 / VAL-107 / VAL-108 / VAL-109 / VAL-110) are preserved unchanged. New blocks added in v0.2. Full universal_reference block with all 14 substantive sub-keys (CHK-5.7); atlases_used_and_deferred block (CHK-5.8) with atlases_run = [Loyfer_25tile, UniLIFE_19cell, Salas_Blood_EPIC_IDOL_6cell] anchored at VAL-108/109/110 and atlases_deferred = [EpiSCORE_HeartRef anchored at VAL-111 with full deferral rationale, Caggiano_CelFiE_TIM_cardiac blocked at HM450 hg19 manifest]; substrate_roadmap block (CHK-5.9) covering all five EDEAR substrates with status/anchor/target/rationale (DNAm validated v0.2 via VAL-108/109/110/111; nucleosome occupancy / fragment fuzziness / WPS / fragment size deferred to v0.4+); chk_3_1_thresholds_per_substrate block (CHK-5.10) with BOTH 3.1A and 3.1B thresholds per all four substrates encountered (TCGA HM450K sesame Level 3, GenomeStudio AVG_Beta HM450K, minfi preprocessFunnorm HM450K, GenomeStudio V2011.1 HM450K raw); lessons_discovered_v0_2 section with six discoveries (DISC-CARDIO-001 through DISC-CARDIO-006), six things v0.2 chose not to claim, and ten things remaining open; commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_validation_limitations block mirroring crc-epic v2.4 structure.

Six discoveries from the cardio sprint (DISC-CARDIO-001 through 006):

  1. DISC-CARDIO-001: Stage 1 immune A-score is the workhorse for cardio-epic across all substrates tested. Strongest cardio signal at v0.2 is VAL-110 normal vs BAV at d=+1.08 — Stage 1 immune A-score on bulk aortic tissue, not a cardio-specific Stage 2 tile.
  2. DISC-CARDIO-002: Substrate-cell match is the single most important cardio biology consideration. VAL-109 cultured PEC vascular tile d=+0.79 vs VAL-110 bulk aorta vascular tile d=−0.04 — same tile, same atlas, same H_min, different sample composition.
  3. DISC-CARDIO-003: Biology-correct nulls are first-class outcomes. VAL-108 sealed at O3_CARDIO_EPIC_3SUBTYPE_UNDIFFERENTIATED documents that the framework correctly does not stratify what biology has homogenized.
  4. DISC-CARDIO-004: Atlas family matters — tile-coverage atlases ≠ gene-promoter atlases at Stage 2 scoring. VAL-111 sealed this with EpiSCORE HeartRef across three cohorts and three substrates. Logged as LL-CARDIO-005.
  5. DISC-CARDIO-005: Substrate-specific CHK-3.1A self-cal envelopes work for cardio at v0.2 — and they are not a generalizable platform threshold yet. Three different β preprocessing pipelines produced three different cohort f_extreme distributions; substrate-equivalence test confirmed a 24-percentage-point distribution gap between GenomeStudio AVG_Beta and TCGA HM450K sesame Level 3.
  6. DISC-CARDIO-006: The cardio sprint exercised the entire CHK-3.1A/B split convention end-to-end for the first time. CHK-5.7/5.8/5.9/5.10 structural-parity gates were added to TESTING_CHECKLIST.md; CHK-5.11 atlas-family fitness gate added 2026-04-29 from LL-CARDIO-005.

CHK-5.11 atlas-family fitness gate (added 2026-04-29). LL-CARDIO-005 formalized that two distinct atlas-scoring modalities exist and they are NOT interchangeable: (a) tile-coverage A-score reading on heterogeneous β panels (Loyfer 25-tile, Caggiano CelFiE TIM); (b) EpiDISH proportion estimation on per-tissue β using gene-promoter integer marker IDs (EpiSCORE family). Cardio-epic Stage 2 needs (a); EpiSCORE HeartRef belongs in (b). VAL-111 sealed the cookbook's first negative atlas-integration result by running an atlas designed for (b) in mode (a). CHK-5.11 was added to TESTING_CHECKLIST.md to formalize the atlas-family fitness check before sealing any future Stage 2 atlas integration.

CCL-044 logged in LESSONS_LEARNED.md. Cardio-epic v0.2 lessons: atlas-substrate match matters at Stage 2; gene-promoter atlases ≠ tile-coverage atlases for A-score tile reading; six discoveries from the cardio sprint formalized.

Cardio-epic v0.2.1 same-day honesty patch + CHK-5.12 + DISC-CARDIO-007 (April 29, 2026, same-day after v0.2 ship)

Same-day audit identified three issues requiring honest correction in a v0.2.1 patch (no sealed VAL outcomes change).

Issue 1 — atlas naming was incomplete in v0.2. v0.2 labeled the cardio Stage 2 atlas "Loyfer 25-tile" with 6,105 CpGs. The actual file is loyfer_moss_2018/reference_atlas.csv — 7,890 CpGs across 25 cell-type columns, the layered Moss + Loyfer array atlas combined into one file per PIPELINE_REFERENCE Part 2.1+2.2 (Moss 2018 primary for cells it covers; Loyfer 2023 supplements for sorted-cell entries Moss didn't have at array CpG resolution: Cortical_neurons, Vascular_endothelial_cells, Left_atrium, EPIC-trained sorted immune, etc.). Both atlases were operative in VAL-108/109/110 scoring; v0.2's naming undersold what was running. v0.2.1 corrects the naming.

Issue 2 — atlases_deferred was incomplete in v0.2. v0.2 listed only 2 deferred atlases (EpiSCORE HeartRef + Caggiano CelFiE TIM). PIPELINE_REFERENCE Part 2.3–2.7 plus TESTING_CHECKLIST §STAGE 0 Queue-1 list name several additional cardio-relevant Stage 2 atlases. Most critically: Konigsberg 2023 cardiovascular 28-cell atlas (Part 2.4) is named as the cardio deployment blocker with the document-of-record statement: "Without this atlas, cardio-epic cannot be deployed." Konigsberg includes sorted cardiomyocytes (terminal class, H_min = 0.7728), cardiac fibroblasts, vascular endothelial, smooth muscle — currently invisible to the layered Moss+Loyfer chain because Moss has no sorted cardiomyocyte entry and Loyfer has only Left_atrium bulk. v0.2.1 expands atlases_deferred from 2 entries to 8: Konigsberg 2023, Caggiano CelFiE TIM, EpiSCORE Zhu/Teschendorff 2022 pan-tissue, Tanaka 2025 6-cell-type neural, Liu 2023 scMCodes, EpiSCORE HeartRef sub-panel (VAL-111 anchor), MARLIN Capper 2025, Sabedot GeLB 2021.

Issue 3 — VAL-108/109/110 scored Stage 2 against ONLY the layered Moss+Loyfer combined atlas. Per the run-everything policy (Heath sign-off 2026-04-26), every IDAT runs Stage 2 against ALL reference atlases in the vault. The other Stage 2 atlases in atlas_vault (caggiano_celfie_2021, caggiano_celfie_tim, episcore_zhu_teschendorff_2022, episcore_heartref pre-VAL-111, marlin_capper_training, sabedot_gelb_2021) were NOT scored on cardio cohorts. v0.2.1 explicitly acknowledges the run-everything violation and queues corrective re-execution of VAL-108/109/110 against the full atlas stack as part of v0.3 critical path.

DISC-CARDIO-007 — Always read PIPELINE_REFERENCE Part 2 first. VAL-111 was scored against EpiSCORE HeartRef because that atlas was already in atlas_vault from a prior acquisition pass. PIPELINE_REFERENCE Part 2.4 explicitly names Konigsberg 2023 — NOT EpiSCORE — as the cardio Stage 2 atlas blocker. The atlas selection in cardio v0.1/v0.2 was made by browsing atlas_vault rather than by reading the canonical document. VAL-111 produced a real and useful negative result (atlas-family-fitness lesson, LL-CARDIO-005), but it was a side-track from the canonical cardio atlas critical path.

CHK-5.12 atlas-canonical-source-check gate (added 2026-04-29 to TESTING_CHECKLIST.md). Before sealing any new atlas integration prereg, the prereg must cite which canonical-document section names the atlas as a production candidate for the card under test. Companion to CHK-5.11 atlas-family-fitness check. Together CHK-5.11 + CHK-5.12 form the "is this the right atlas to test?" gate before any atlas integration VAL is sealed. CCL-045 logged in LESSONS_LEARNED.md.

v0.3 critical path documented in card JSON canonical_documents_named_blocker_for_cardio_deployment block.
